title: When Does Uncertainty Measure RAG Hallucination Risk?
abstract: arXiv:2610.22615v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Uncertainty can measure hallucination risk in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), but only when retrieved evidence constrains the answer. When evidence is present, unsupported factual claims become less likely; when retrieval coverage is poor, the model can answer from internal knowledge and assign high probability to unsupported claims. We test this across four instruction-tuned models on HotpotQA and SQuAD. After matching faithful and hallucinated answers within word-count bins, length-only classifiers fall near chance, while perplexity reaches 0.81--0.91 AUROC on targeted unsupported edits. Varying retrieval depth shows why the score changes meaning: detection can weaken with only the top-ranked passage, then recover after adding a second passage. translated_title: 不确定性何时能衡量RAG的幻觉风险？
translated_abstract: 不确定性可以衡量检索增强生成（RAG）中的幻觉风险，但前提是检索到的证据对答案构成约束。当证据存在时，无依据的事实性声明出现的可能性会降低；而当检索覆盖不足时，模型可能依靠内部知识作答，从而给无依据的声明分配较高的概率。我们在HotpotQA和SQuAD数据集上，使用四个指令微调模型对这一假设进行了测试。在按字数区间匹配忠实回答与幻觉回答后，仅基于长度的分类器表现接近随机水平，而困惑度在针对性的无依据编辑上达到了0.81–0.91的AUROC。通过改变检索深度的实验揭示了该指标意义发生变化的原因：仅使用排名第一的段落时检测能力可能减弱，而加入第二个段落后又会恢复。结合不确定性与语义漂移的综合评分进一步改善了校准效果，且在RAGTruth QA上的测量结果仍高于随机水平。这些结果支持一种条件性的观点，即不确定性在特定条件下才是衡量幻觉风险的有效指标。
tldr: 论文提出并验证了一个条件性观点——不确定性只有在检索证据足以约束答案时才能有效衡量RAG的幻觉风险，实验表明困惑度在针对性无依据编辑检测中达到0.81–0.91 AUROC，且结合语义漂移评分可进一步提升校准效果。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a conditional view that uncertainty measures RAG hallucination risk only when retrieved evidence constrains the answer, showing perplexity achieves 0.81–0.91 AUROC on targeted unsupported edits and that a combined uncertainty-plus-semantic-drift score further improves calibration.
